- content:

```
const puppeteer = require('puppeteer');
const fs = require('fs');

(async () => {
  const url = 'http://localhost:3000/www/index.html';
  const browser = await puppeteer.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox','--disable-setuid-sandbox'] });
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  await page.setViewport({ width: 960, height: 600 });

  console.log('loading', url);
  await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle2' });

  // wait for canvas to be present and for wasm to initialize (canvas sized)
  await page.waitForSelector('#screen');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => {
    const c = document.getElementById('screen');
    return c && c.width > 0 && c.height > 0;
  }, { timeout: 5000 });

  // helper to capture the canvas only
  async function capture(name) {
    const clip = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const c = document.getElementById('screen');
      const rect = c.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: rect.width, height: rect.height };
    });
    const file = `screenshots/${name}.png`;
    await page.screenshot({ path: file, clip });
    console.log('saved', file);
  }

  if (!fs.existsSync('screenshots')) fs.mkdirSync('screenshots');

  // initial state
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  await capture('initial');

  // move forward for 1s
  await page.keyboard.down('ArrowUp');
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  await page.keyboard.up('ArrowUp');
  await capture('forward_1s');

  // rotate right while moving forward to approach a corner
  await page.keyboard.down('ArrowRight');
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  await page.keyboard.up('ArrowRight');

  await page.keyboard.down('ArrowUp');
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  await page.keyboard.up('ArrowUp');
  await capture('approach_corner');

  // strafe right into corner
  await page.keyboard.down('Period'); // strafe right
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  await page.keyboard.up('Period');
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  await capture('after_strafe');

  await browser.close();
  console.log('done');
})();
```

- filePath: `/Users/andreacollet/Projects/raycasting-webassembly-demo/tools/screenshot.js`
